errors.text_span: 该饼图展示了在“男性动词语义域分布”中各类动词语义范畴的占比情况
errors.evidence: The figure contains two connected pie charts (a main chart and a secondary chart breaking down the '其他' slice), not a single pie chart. The description incorrectly treats all slices as belonging to a single chart, fundamentally misrepresenting the structure and data relationships.

errors.text_span: 并标注了其在总样本中的百分比
errors.evidence: This statement is false for the slices shown in the right-hand pie chart. Their percentages are relative to the '其他' (Other) category (which is 19.38% of the total), not relative to the total sample.

errors.text_span: 最大的切片为“物态事态”，占比23.4%
errors.evidence: The largest slice in the overall distribution is '生活工作' (Life/Work) at 23.3%. '物态事态' is the largest slice only within the secondary chart, and its actual proportion of the total is much smaller (23.4% of 19.38%, which is approximately 4.5%).

errors.text_span: “其他”类别占比19.38%，颜色为浅灰色
errors.evidence: The color of the '其他' (Other) slice in the main pie chart is dark blue, not '浅灰色' (light grey).

errors.text_span: “身体动作”占比9.9%，颜色为深蓝色
errors.evidence: The color of the '身体动作' (Body movements) slice is a medium or light blue, not '深蓝色' (dark blue). The dark blue slice corresponds to '生理活动' (Physiological activities).
The color of the '争斗' (Struggle/Fight) slice is dark purple/maroon, not '深红色' (deep red). The deep red slice is '战争' (War).
The color of the '交通' (Traffic/Transportation) slice is a light teal or blue-green, not '浅蓝色' (light blue).
The color of the '判断' (Judgment) slice is a light teal or blue-green, similar to '交通', not '浅灰色' (light grey).
The color of the '文教' (Culture/Education) slice is dark purplish-brown/maroon, not '深蓝色' (dark blue).

errors.text_span: 整体来看，切片按大小顺序排列
errors.evidence: The slices in neither the main chart nor the secondary chart are arranged in order of size.
The description fails to mention the total number of slices in each chart (8 in the main chart, 10 in the secondary chart), which was requested by the prompt.

errors.text_span: 旨在通过多语体语料库与依存分析揭示汉语中与男性相关的动词在语义上的分布特征
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence interprets the purpose of the research using information from the paper title, rather than strictly describing what the chart itself shows. The prompt asks to avoid interpretation.
